easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: Everything from the original series through the Saiyan arc.
easy.spoiler: Safe through the Saiyan arc, give or take two facts from Namek.

questions.q: How many Dragon Balls do you need to summon Shenron?
questions.note: And then they scatter and turn to stone for a year.

questions.q: What race is Goku?
questions.note: Sent to Earth as an infant, and hit his head hard enough to forget the mission.

questions.q: What is Goku's Saiyan birth name?
questions.note: Vegeta refuses to call him anything else for about a decade.

questions.q: Which master does Goku train under before his first World Tournament?
questions.note: The Turtle Hermit, and the reason the Kamehameha exists.

questions.q: What happens to a Saiyan with a tail who looks at a full moon?
a: They turn into a giant ape
questions.note: The Oozaru. Goku never remembered a moment of it — Vegeta, who trained for it, keeps control.

questions.q: Who destroyed Planet Vegeta?
questions.note: Because he was afraid of what the Saiyans might become.

questions.q: Who is Goku's older brother?
questions.note: He arrives to collect a soldier and finds a father.

questions.q: What title does Vegeta insist on?
questions.note: Of a planet that no longer exists.

questions.q: Who is Goku's first son?
questions.note: Named after the grandfather who raised Goku.

questions.q: Which technique does Goku learn from King Kai?
questions.note: Also the Kaio-ken. Both on a planet the size of a garden.

questions.q: What colour does a Super Saiyan's hair turn?
questions.note: And the eyes go green.

questions.q: Who does Piccolo train after Raditz?
questions.note: It starts as kidnapping and ends as the most important relationship in the show.

questions.q: What is Kami's job?
questions.note: And he is the same being as Piccolo, split in two.

questions.q: Who is Bulma looking for when she meets Goku?
questions.note: She built the radar that finds them.

questions.q: What is the Spirit Bomb made from?
a: Energy borrowed from everything alive nearby
questions.note: Which is why it fails whenever nobody is listening.

questions.q: Who is Goku's wife?
questions.note: He agreed to marry her as a child without knowing what marriage was.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: Namek, the androids, Cell and Buu.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers through the end of Dragon Ball Z.

questions.q: What finally pushes Goku into Super Saiyan on Namek?
questions.note: The rage of a gentle heart, as the legend puts it.

questions.q: Who does Future Trunks kill on arrival?
questions.note: In about forty seconds, to establish exactly how bad the future is.

questions.q: Which two androids does Cell need to become perfect?
questions.note: He absorbs them through his tail.

questions.q: Who actually defeats Cell?
questions.note: One-armed, and only after losing his temper completely.

questions.q: How much time passes inside the Hyperbolic Time Chamber for one day outside?
questions.note: And you can only use it so many times in a lifetime.

questions.q: Who created Majin Buu?
questions.note: Babidi is the son, and considerably less impressive.

questions.q: What is the dragon of the Namekian Dragon Balls called?
questions.note: And he grants three wishes instead of one.

questions.q: What kills Goku in Future Trunks' timeline?
questions.note: Which is why Trunks brings medicine as well as a warning.

questions.q: Who does Vegeta let control him in the Buu arc?
questions.note: Majin Vegeta, chasing one honest fight.

questions.q: Which android refuses to fight and loves animals?
questions.note: And his death is what finally breaks Gohan.

questions.q: Who does Krillin marry?
questions.note: After wishing away her self-destruct device.

questions.q: What is the fusion of Goten and Trunks called?
questions.note: The dance has to be perfect, which it very often is not.

questions.q: Where does Goku learn Instant Transmission?
questions.note: After the Namek explosion, while everyone assumed he was dead.

questions.q: Who does Piccolo fuse with to fight Frieza?
questions.note: And later with Kami, becoming whole for the first time.

questions.q: How does Mr. Satan genuinely save the world?
a: He talks the Earth into giving Goku energy
questions.note: And befriending Buu was not nothing either.

questions.q: What does the Potara earring fusion produce from Goku and Vegeta?
questions.note: The dance gives Gogeta. The earrings give Vegito.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: Gods of destruction, Ultra Instinct and everything after Z.
hard.spoiler: Spoilers for Super, the films and the ongoing manga.

questions.q: What does the Super Saiyan God ritual require?
a: Six righteous Saiyans lending their power to a seventh
A wish on the Namekian balls
questions.note: Which only works because Videl is pregnant.

questions.q: Who is Whis?
a: Beerus's attendant and martial arts teacher
questions.note: An angel, and comfortably stronger than the god he serves.

questions.q: Who is Goku Black?
questions.note: Swapped bodies using the Super Dragon Balls.

questions.q: Which universe is Jiren from?
questions.note: Pride Trooper, and the strongest mortal in the multiverse.

questions.q: What is at stake in the Tournament of Power?
a: Wishes on the Super Dragon Balls only
The title of God of Destruction
questions.note: Zeno decided the rules on a whim, which is the horror of it.

questions.q: What does Vegeta develop as an answer to Ultra Instinct?
questions.note: It grows stronger the more damage he takes. Very him.

questions.q: Who is Goku's father?
questions.note: A low-class soldier who saw one thing coming.

questions.q: Which arc introduced Granolah?
a: The Granolah the Survivor arc in the manga
questions.note: The last Cerealian, who wished to become the strongest in the universe.

questions.q: What form does Gohan reach in Super Hero?
questions.note: Triggered by Piccolo being beaten in front of him. It always is.

questions.q: What is Frieza's gold form called?
questions.note: And later Black Frieza, after ten years in a time chamber.

questions.q: Who is Zeno?
a: The Omni-King, who rules all universes
questions.note: A childlike being who can erase existence by accident.

questions.q: What does Beerus's Hakai do?
questions.note: Vegeta learns a version of it, which is not supposed to be possible.

questions.q: Which Universe 6 Saiyan does Vegeta take on as a student?
questions.note: Vegeta drags the first Super Saiyan out of him by threatening the planet he is proud of.

questions.q: What is Hit's ability?
questions.note: Time-skip, and it gets longer every time he uses it.

questions.q: How is Broly's canon version introduced?
a: In the 2018 film Dragon Ball Super: Broly
questions.note: The earlier films are not part of the same story.

questions.q: What does Ultra Instinct let a fighter do?
a: Move and counter without thinking about it
Copy any technique once he has seen it
questions.note: Whis teaches it as letting the body decide. Mastered, the hair turns silver.
